instruction: Set my weekend wake up alarm snooze to 15 minutes.
notes: Single-app task (phone). The weekend wake-up alarm exists but its id is unknown initially; phone.show_alarms discovers it (known-id), phone.show_alarm confirms it is the weekend wake-up alarm (found-weekend-wake-up), and phone.update_alarm is called with only alarm_id, access_token and snooze_minutes=15 so that snooze_minutes is the sole changed field. The static facts (is-weekend-wake-up ...) and (target-snooze minutes-15) encode which record and value the task targets; supervisor.complete_task takes the alarm and minutes as non-API record parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal and it is forced to be last. No answer is passed to complete_task since the task is not a question.
